paper.title: A Unified Framework of Policy Learning for Contextual Bandit with Confounding Bias and Missing Observations

settings.name_in_paper: Confounded contextual bandit with instrumental variable (CCB-IV) and missingness, offline
unmapped: offline learning from a fixed logged dataset of T trials (no interaction)
unmeasured confounder U affecting action, context and reward in the logging policy
instrumental variable side observation Z
context and side observations missing not at random
context distribution shift between observational and interventional process
general (possibly continuous) action space with function approximation (hypothesis class H, test class Theta)
performance measured by suboptimality of returned policy against best policy in class Pi
settings.definition_quote: In a confounded contextual bandit with instrumental variable (CCB-IV) shown in Figure \ref{fig:CCB-IV}, $O$ corresponds to instrumental variable $Z$, which is assumed to be independent of confounder $U$ and outcome $Y$. ... SubOpt(\pi) = v^{\pi^*} - v^{\pi}.

settings.name_in_paper: Confounded contextual bandit with proxy variables (CCB-PV) and missingness, offline
unmapped: offline learning from a fixed logged dataset
unmeasured confounder U
negative control proxies (Z, W)
context and proxies missing not at random
context distribution shift
function approximation for bridge functions
suboptimality against best policy in class Pi
settings.definition_quote: In a confounded contextual bandit with proxy variables (CCB-PV) shown in Figure \ref{fig:CCB-PV}, $O$ corresponds to the negative controls $(Z, W)$. It is assumed that $W\indep A\given (U, X)$ holds for the outcome proxy $W$ and $Z\indep (Y, W)\given (A, X, U)$ holds for the treatment proxy $Z$.

settings.name_in_paper: CCB-PV with extended policy class (policy depends on context X and outcome proxy W)
unmapped: offline learning
unmeasured confounder
proxy variables missing not at random
interventional policy may depend on side observation W
policy-specific identification
suboptimality against best policy in class Pi
settings.definition_quote: we consider an extension of the CCB-PV setting where the interventional policy class is given by $\pie\in\Pie:\cX\times\cW\rightarrow \Delta(\cA)$.

settings.name_in_paper: Two-step linear dynamic treatment regime (DTR) with confounding and missingness
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Two-stage sequential decision problem (dynamic treatment regime), offline RL rather than a bandit.
unmapped: offline two-stage DTR
first-stage reward used as instrumental variable
linear bridge and dual function classes
transition p(x2|x1,a1) assumed known
settings.definition_quote: We consider a DTRs with two steps... the first state reward $Y_1$ serves as an instrumental variable to $A_2$.

settings.name_in_paper: One-step linear POMDP (mapped to CCB-PV with extended policy class)
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Partially observable MDP (one-step) offline policy learning; RL-flavoured application rather than a standard bandit.
unmapped: offline one-step POMDP with hidden state as confounder
observations missing not at random
softmax linear policy class
linear bridge functions
settings.definition_quote: We consider a one-step Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) following the example in \citep{shi2021minimax, uehara2021finite}.

symbols.eps_Theta: compatibility error of test function class

conditions: Assumption 5 (CCB-IV model assumptions: structured reward, IV completeness, IV independence, outcome-independent missingness)
existence of b_1 solving E[b_1(Z)|A,X,R_Z=1] = p~(x)pi*(a|x)/p_ob(x,a|R_Z=1)

source.label: thm:IV subopt
source.quote: The sub-optimality corresponding to $\piepessi$ for the CCB-IV is bounded on event $\cE$ with probability at least $1-4\xi$ by \SubOpt(\piepessi) \overset{\cE}{\lesssim} \sum_{k=1}^2 \nbr{b_k}_{\mu_k, 2}\cdot \big(\cO(\vareTheta) + \cO(\vareH) + \cO\rbr{\sqrt{e_\cD}} +  \cO\rbr{\eta}\big)

results.notes: Suboptimality of returned policy (offline), mapped to simple_regret. Probability 1-4xi. Paper notes that with eta ~ O~(T^{-1/2}) and zero approximation errors, SubOpt ~ O~(T^{-1/2}).

conditions: existence of b_1 satisfying the PV ratio equation

source.label: thm:PV subopt
source.quote: The sub-optimality corresponding to $\piepessi$ for the CCB-PV is bounded with probability at least $1-8\xi$ by \SubOpt(\piepessi) \lesssim \sum_{k=1}^4 \nbr{b_k}_{\mu_k, 2}\cdot \big(\cO(\vareTheta) + \cO(\vareH) + \cO\rbr{\sqrt{e_\cD}} +  \cO\rbr{\eta}\big)

symbols.eta_crit: critical radius bound for classes including the policy class

source.quote: The sub-optimality corresponding to $\piepessi$ for the CCB-PV with extended policy class is bounded with probability at least $1-8\xi$ by \SubOpt(\piepessi) \lesssim \sum_{k=1}^4 \nbr{b_k}_{\mu_k, 2} \cdot \rbr{O(\vareTheta) + O(\vareH) + O\rbr{\sqrt{e_\cD}} +  O\rbr{\eta}}

conditions: Assumptions 20 and 21 (linear bridge and dual function classes)

source.quote: The sub-optimality of $\piepessi$ for the two-step DTRs is bounded with probability at least $1-4\xi$ by \SubOpt(\piepessi) \lesssim  \rbr{\nbr{b_1}_{\mu_1, 2}+\nbr{b_2}_{\mu_2, 2}}\cdot \rbr{O\rbr{\sqrt{e_\cD}} +  O\rbr{\eta}}
